candidates.name: Baseline Chen2020
candidates.role: baseline characterization of the default NMC811/graphite system (5 Ah nominal, architecture defaults)

candidates.name: ED-Compact A
candidates.role: dead-layer thinning: separator 12->9 um, current collectors 16/12->10/8 um (contract ED volume shrink, no capacity change)

candidates.name: ED-Compact B
candidates.role: A + electrode compaction: active fraction up / porosity down (volume fractions stay physical), nominal capacity updated to designed loading 5.6 Ah so 1C stays a true 1C

candidates.name: ED-Thick C
candidates.role: A + thicken the capacity-limiting negative electrode 85.2->110 um (dilutes dead layers, raises N/P from 0.82 to ~1.06), nominal updated to 6.4 Ah

llm_reason: Contract ED (Wh/L) = discharge energy / stack volume. Levers: (1) dead-layer thinning (separator/CC) shrinks volume at fixed energy; (2) raising the capacity of the capacity-limiting negative electrode (active fraction up with porosity down, or thickness up) raises energy with less-than-proportional volume growth; (3) nominal capacity is kept consistent with designed loading so 1C/4C currents are genuine C-rates. Expected: plateau ~3.6-3.7 V for all (material gap, recorded; ceiling_escalation OFF -> no system switch). 4C safety screened in R2.
